title: When Is Deletion Ordering Tractable? From Update Dynamics to Permutation Structure
abstract: arXiv:2610.01149v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Given a fixed set of pending deletion requests, retraining from scratch after each request is prohibitive, so a prescribed request-wise policy processes them sequentially. The resulting terminal model can depend on their order. Rather than prescribing an ordering rule, we study the permutation objective induced by the fixed policy and ask when it admits simpler structure. We identify two independent reductions: position additivity represents the objective by request--position costs, reducing optimization to assignment and, with a shared positional profile, sorting; suffix localization removes dependence on the distant prefix while retaining interactions among the surviving requests. Under shared affine updates, we characterize the quadratic interactions that obstruct additivity, prove the reductions' independence, and show that suffix-conditioned assignment improves the approximation rate from O(p^L)   toO(p^(2L)). Experiments recover

translated_title: 何时删除排序是易解的？从更新动力学到排列结构
translated_abstract: 给定一组固定的待处理删除请求，在每次请求之后都从头重新训练的代价过高，因此采用预设的逐请求策略依次处理。由此得到的最终模型可能取决于请求的处理顺序。本文不预设任何排序规则，而是研究由固定策略诱导的排列目标函数，并探讨该目标何时具有更简单的结构。我们识别出两种相互独立的约简：位置可加性用“请求—位置”代价来表示目标函数，从而将优化约简为分配问题；在共享位置剖面下则进一步约简为排序问题。后缀局部化则消除对远端前缀的依赖，同时保留存活请求之间的相互作用。在共享仿射更新条件下，我们刻画了阻碍可加性的二次交互项，证明了两种约简的相互独立性，并证明后缀条件化的分配方法可将近似误差率从 O(p^L) 改进至 O(p^(2L))。（注：原文摘要末尾"Experiments recover"处疑似被截断，实验部分内容不完整。）
tldr: 该论文研究了删除请求处理顺序何时具有可解的简单结构，识别出位置可加性与后缀局部化两种相互独立的约简，并证明后缀条件化分配可将近似误差率从 O(p^L) 改进至 O(p^(2L))。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes when the permutation objective induced by a fixed deletion-request policy admits simpler structure, identifying two independent reductions—position additivity and suffix localization—and proving that suffix-conditioned assignment improves the approximation rate from O(p^L) to O(p^(2L)).
